events.title: Written by the Stars, Crafted by Hand: Handcraft a Valentine inspired by the Qixi Festival
events.description: The Qixi Festival (七夕节) celebrates the romantic legend of Niulang (牛郎), the cowherd and Zhinü ( 織女 ), the weaver girl. These star-crossed lovers can be seen in the night sky as the constellations Vega and Altair, separated by the Silver River (Milky Way) as they wait for the one night a year they can be together. events.title: Kuhio Beach Hula Show
events.description: Free outdoor Hawaiian music and hula show at the Kuhio Beach Hula Mound in Waikiki, presented by Hawaii's finest halau hula (dance troupes) for over 30 years.
